name: PT Malindo Feedmill Tbk
summary: PT Malindo Feedmill Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the animal feed, breeding and broiler farm, and food processing businesses in Indonesia. It offers broiler, layer, duck, and other livestock feed products; and parent stock and day old chicken final stock. The company also produces broiler chickens; and provides consumer products, such as chicken nuggets, chicken tempura, chicken sticks, chicken wings, tulip wings, chicken karaage, chicken drumstick, chicken sausage, and combined variant packs under the SunnyGold and Ciki Wiki brands. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia. PT Malindo Feedmill Tbk is a subsidiary of Dragon Amity Pte. Ltd.
